hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that routes swaps through Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes input/output amounts using a configurable concentrated-liquidity curve, deposits input tokens into and withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to handle all swap accounting directly, bypassing standard Uniswap pool liquidity.
